items.description:

Strong winds until later.

##State of sea)##

Moderate, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Patchy light rain and drizzle, with areas of mist and isolated fog patches.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or good, falling poor in rain, drizzle or mist, and very poor in any fog.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

11°C
